greeting: Hi! Thanks for contacting {{business.name}}. I'm the AI assistant here to help with roofing questions, schedule inspections, or provide quotes. What can I help you with today?
after_hours: Hi! You've reached {{business.name}}. We're currently closed but will respond first thing during business hours ({{business.hours}}). If this is an emergency with active water intrusion, please call our emergency line.
appointment_request: I'd be happy to schedule a roof inspection! What day works best for you? We have availability this week.
pricing_inquiry: I'd be happy to provide a quote! The cost depends on your roof size, materials, and any damage. Can you tell me approximately how many square feet your roof is, or how many stories your home is?
storm_damage: I'm sorry to hear about the storm damage! We specialize in storm damage repairs and work directly with insurance companies. When did the storm hit your area? And do you see any visible damage or water coming in?
insurance_question: Yes — we work with insurance claims regularly. Most homeowners first schedule a roof inspection so we can document the damage properly. Have you already filed a claim, or would you like help with that process?
emergency_repair: If water is actively entering the home, we recommend scheduling an emergency inspection immediately. Can I help book that now? We have emergency slots available today.
service_inquiry: We offer comprehensive roofing services including storm damage repair, roof replacement, emergency leak repair, and insurance claim assistance. Which service do you need?
unknown: Thanks for your message! Let me make sure I understand correctly. Are you looking for a roof repair quote, storm damage assessment, or scheduling an inspection?
follow_up: Just following up on your roofing inquiry! Are you still interested in scheduling that inspection with {{business.name}}?
final_follow_up: Hi! This is my final follow-up. If you're still interested in {{business.name}} for your roofing needs, just reply anytime. Have a great day!
booking_confirmed: Great! You're all set for a roof inspection on {{appointment.date}} at {{appointment.time}}. We'll see you then! Please have your insurance info ready if this is a storm damage claim.
appointment_reminder: Reminder: You have a roof inspection with {{business.name}} tomorrow at {{appointment.time}}. See you then!
opt_out: You've been removed from our follow-up list. If you need roofing services in the future, just reach out!
busy: Thanks for your patience! We're handling a high volume of storm damage inquiries but will get back to you shortly.
photo_request: To better assess your roof condition, could you send me a few photos of the damage? You can text them directly to this number. Photos help us prepare the right materials and give you a more accurate quote.
hail_damage: Hail damage can be tricky to spot from the ground. Common signs include dented gutters, damaged siding, and granules in your downspouts. Would you like me to schedule a free inspection to assess the full extent of the damage?
wind_damage: Wind damage often causes lifted or missing shingles. Even if you don't see obvious damage from the ground, the seal may be broken. An inspection will identify any issues that could lead to leaks.
leak_response: Active leaks can cause serious interior damage. A few quick questions: Is the water still coming in? Which room is affected? And when did you first notice the leak? This helps us prioritize your repair.
